title: 2-D Shapes and 3-D Objects: Circles, Squares, Balls and Boxes
seo_title: Grade R Shapes and Objects Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Recognise and name 3-D objects (ball shapes and box shapes) in the classroom and in pictures; recognise, identify and name 2-D shapes such as circles, triangles and squares.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade R maths worksheets: circles, triangles, squares and rectangles, ball and box shapes, and shapes around us. 100 questions with pictures and memos.
key_sub: A ball rolls; a box slides.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • 2-D shapes are flat: circle, triangle, square, rectangle.
  • A circle is round; a triangle has 3 sides.
  • 3-D objects are solid: ball shapes roll, box shapes slide.
  • Look for shapes in the classroom and at home.

Examples

Example

A shape with 3 straight sides

count the sides

Answer: triangle

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Square or rectangleA square has 4 equal sides.
Flat or solidA ball is solid; a circle is flat.
Missing oneMark each shape as you count it.
